domain: smw-integration

}}

{{Documentation}}
[[Category:BITwiki Templates]]
[[Category:BITwiki Book Matter]]


= BITwiki SMW Template System: Semantic MediaWiki Integration =

== Purpose ==

This document defines BITwiki's Semantic MediaWiki (SMW) template architecture—enabling machine-queryable, semantically rich content that transcends traditional wiki limitations. Unlike Wikipedia's static categories, BITwiki templates encode ontological relationships, epistemic status, and computable properties.

== Template Architecture ==

=== Design Principles ===

# '''Semantic First''': Every template encodes machine-readable properties
# '''Epistemic Transparency''': All claims carry confidence and status metadata
# '''Transclusion Hygiene''': Clear boundaries between template logic and content
# '''Composability''': Templates nest and combine without conflict
# '''Queryability''': All data extractable via SMW #ask queries

=== Template Categories ===

| Category | Purpose | Examples |
|----------|---------|----------|
| Infobox | Entity metadata display | Infobox_Concept, Infobox_Agent |
| Marker | Epistemic status indicators | Epistemic_Marker, Uncertainty_Marker |
| Navigation | Cross-page linking | Navigation_Box, Portal_Template |
| Query | Reusable query patterns | Related_Pages, Property_Listing |
| Formatting | Consistent presentation | Citation_Box, Definition_Box |

== Core Templates ==

=== Template:Infobox_Entity ===

'''Purpose:''' Universal entity metadata container

'''Usage:'''
```
{{Infobox_Entity
|entity_type=Concept
|name=Autopoiesis
|definition=Self-producing system that generates its own components
|domain=Systems Science
|epistemic_status=Established
|confidence=0.92
|created_by=Maturana and Varela
|creation_date=1972
|key_properties=Self-reference, Boundary maintenance, Component generation
|related_entities=Cybernetics, Homeostasis, Emergence
|source_count=47
}}
```

'''SMW Properties Set:'''
* [[Has entity type::{{#var:entity_type}}]]
* [[Has name::{{#var:name}}]]
* [[Has domain::{{#var:domain}}]]
* [[Has epistemic status::{{#var:epistemic_status}}]]
* [[Has confidence::{{#var:confidence}}]]
* [[Has creation date::{{#var:creation_date}}]]

=== Template:Epistemic_Marker ===

'''Purpose:''' Visual and semantic epistemic status indicator

'''Usage:'''
```
{{Epistemic_Marker
|status=Established
|confidence=0.87
|sources=12
|last_verified=2026-02-13
}}
```

'''Visual Output:'''
[Established] ●●●●○ (0.87) | 12 sources | Verified 2026-02-13

'''SMW Properties:'''
* [[Has epistemic status::{{#var:status}}]]
* [[Has confidence::{{#var:confidence}}]]
* [[Has source count::{{#var:sources}}]]
* [[Has verification date::{{#var:last_verified}}]]

'''Status Values:'''
* 🔴 Axiomatic (1.0)
* 🟢 Established (0.85-0.99)
* 🟡 Supported (0.70-0.84)
* 🔵 Working (0.50-0.69)
* ⚪ Speculative (0.20-0.49)
* ⚫ Disputed (variable)

=== Template:Uncertainty_Marker ===

'''Purpose:''' Granular uncertainty quantification

'''Usage:'''
```
{{Uncertainty_Marker
|type=Measurement
|value=0.15
|unit=confidence_interval
|description=Standard error of measurement
}}
```

'''Types:'''
* Measurement: Instrument precision
* Statistical: Confidence intervals
* Epistemic: Knowledge limitations
* Temporal: Time-based uncertainty
* Ontological: Category boundary fuzziness

=== Template:Property_Citation ===

'''Purpose:''' Link properties to evidence sources

'''Usage:'''
```
{{Property_Citation
|property=Has population
|value=8.1 billion
|source=UN World Population Prospects 2024
|url=https://population.un.org/
|access_date=2026-02-13
|confidence=0.95
}}
```

'''SMW Properties:'''
* [[Has property::{{#var:property}}]]
* [[Has value::{{#var:value}}]]
* [[Has citation::{{#var:source}}]]
* [[Has source URL::{{#var:url}}]]
* [[Has access date::{{#var:access_date}}]]

== Query Templates ==

=== Template:Related_Entities ===

'''Purpose:''' Dynamic entity relationship discovery

'''Usage:'''
```
{{Related_Entities
|entity={{PAGENAME}}
|relationship=Has related entity
|limit=10
|format=list
}}
```

'''Implementation:'''
```
{{#ask: [[{{#var:relationship}}::{{#var:entity}}]]
 |?Has entity type
 |?Has epistemic status
 |format={{#var:format}}
 |limit={{#var:limit}}
 |sort=Has confidence
 |order=desc
}}
```

=== Template:Domain_Index ===

'''Purpose:''' Auto-generated domain content listing

'''Usage:'''
```
{{Domain_Index
|domain=Systems Science
|include_subdomains=true
|min_confidence=0.70
}}
```

'''Output:''' Table of all entities in domain with confidence filtering

=== Template:Epistemic_Distribution ===

'''Purpose:''' Visualize epistemic status across content

'''Usage:'''
```
{{Epistemic_Distribution
|category=BITwiki Article
|chart_type=pie
}}
```

'''Output:''' Pie chart showing distribution of epistemic tiers

== Transclusion Hygiene ==

===  Boundaries ===

'''Required for:'''
* Template documentation
* SMW property declarations
* Category assignments
* Maintenance categories

'''Example:'''
```
<noinclude>
{{Documentation}}
[[Category:BITwiki Templates]]
[[Category:Infobox Templates]]


<!-- Template logic here -->

```

=== Parameter Validation ===

'''Default Values:'''
```
{{#vardefine: confidence | {{#if: {{{confidence|}}} | {{{confidence}}} | 0.50 }} }}
```

'''Type Checking:'''
```
{{#if: {{#expr: {{#var:confidence}} > 0 and {{#var:confidence}} <= 1 }}
 | <!-- valid -->
 | [[Category:Template Error/Invalid Confidence]]
}}
```

=== Nesting Rules ===

'''Maximum Depth:''' 5 levels
'''Circular Detection:''' SMW query timeout prevents infinite loops
'''Parameter Passing:''' Explicit only, no global state

== Advanced Patterns ==

=== Conditional Display ===

'''Epistemic Status-Based:'''
```
{{#switch: {{#var:epistemic_status}}
 | Axiomatic = [[File:Axiomatic_icon.svg|20px]]
 | Established = [[File:Established_icon.svg|20px]]
 | Supported = [[File:Supported_icon.svg|20px]]
 | #default = [[File:Working_icon.svg|20px]]
}}
```

=== Computed Properties ===

'''Confidence Aggregation:'''
```
{{#expr: 
  ({{#ask: [[Has entity::{{PAGENAME}}]] [[Has confidence::+]]
    |?Has confidence
    |format=sum
  }} / {{#ask: [[Has entity::{{PAGENAME}}]]
    |format=count
  }})
}}
```

=== Temporal Queries ===

'''Recently Updated:'''
```
{{#ask: [[Category:BITwiki Article]]
  [[Modification date::>{{#expr:{{#time:U}}-604800}}]]
 |?Has epistemic status
 |?Modification date
 |format=table
 |sort=Modification date
 |order=desc
}}
```

== SMW Property Definitions ==

=== Core Properties ===

```
[[Has type::Page]] properties:
- Has entity type
- Has domain
- Has epistemic status
- Has related entity
- Has prerequisite

[[Has type::Number]] properties:
- Has confidence (range: 0-1)
- Has source count
- Has version

[[Has type::Date]] properties:
- Has creation date
- Has verification date
- Has modification date

[[Has type::Text]] properties:
- Has definition
- Has description
- Has source URL
```

=== Property Constraints ===

'''Confidence:'''
* Type: Number
* Range: 0.0 to 1.0
* Display format: Percentage

'''Epistemic Status:'''
* Allowed values: Axiomatic, Established, Supported, Working, Speculative, Disputed
* Display format: Icon + text

== Integration with Coraline's Templates ==

Coraline's templates (Infobox_Concept, Infobox_Project, etc.) are extended with:

# '''Additional SMW properties''' for queryability
# '''Epistemic markers''' for transparency
# '''Validation rules''' for data quality
# '''Documentation''' for maintainability

'''Migration Path:'''
* Phase 1: Add SMW properties to existing templates
* Phase 2: Implement epistemic markers
* Phase 3: Add query templates
* Phase 4: Deprecate non-semantic templates

== Validation Checklist ==

=== Template Creation ===
* [ ] SMW properties defined
* [ ] <noinclude> boundaries correct
* [ ] Default values set
* [ ] Documentation included
* [ ] Categories assigned
* [ ] Test cases written

=== Template Usage ===
* [ ] Parameters validated
* [ ] Epistemic status appropriate
* [ ] Sources cited
* [ ] Confidence justified
* [ ] Queryable via SMW

== Conclusion ==

BITwiki's SMW template system transforms static articles into living knowledge graphs. By encoding semantics at the template level, we enable:
* Machine-queryable content
* Dynamic relationship discovery
* Epistemic transparency
* Automated quality assessment
* Cross-domain reasoning

This is not merely templating—it is the infrastructure for recursive knowledge.
